verdict.rationale: On its payroll page, Rippling documents integration with accounting systems such as Xero, QuickBooks, and NetSuite. That covers the core destination systems named in the story. However, the evidence never says that payroll journal entries specifically are synced, or that the sync is automatic. Missing for 10: explicit journal-entry/GL sync documentation, evidence of automatic (vs. manual export) syncing, GL mapping details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
